pinecone-kb._comment: @pinecone-database/mcp-server does not exist on npm, and the real @pinecone-database/mcp package only supports Pinecone indexes with integrated inference. Our index uses externally-generated OpenAI embeddings, so this binds to a local Python MCP server (mcp_servers/pinecone_kb_mcp/server.py) that queries it directly.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Semantic search over the department knowledge base stored in Pinecone. Requires a namespace parameter to scope results to a single department.

query.description: Natural language citizen question to search for.

top_k.description: Number of matching chunks to return.
